detailed_description:

The target video uses a handheld filmic vlog style with soft halation, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, and warm late-afternoon sunlight raking across the white wall. Global rules: no dialogue; every gesture is prop-free and hands return to a natural rest between gestures; the storefront layout stays fixed (window left, door right, "AFOUR" letters between) and no prop ever moves except where explicitly described; a light breeze stirs her hair in every shot.

[Shot 1] The video opens dreamy and slightly defocused with gentle halation, then racks into sharp focus within the first second. A medium shot at a three-quarter back angle shows <Subject 1> standing on the terrazzo pavement in front of the white wall of <Subject 2>, left of the wooden door, one hand raised to her brow to shade her eyes as she gazes up into the warm slanted sunlight. The breeze lifts wispy strands from her messy bun. Noticing the camera, she turns over her right shoulder while her other hand instinctively presses down the wind-blown hair on top of her head; her lips part in a small surprised "oh" that melts into a soft smile as her eyes meet the lens. The wooden window with sheer white curtains glows behind her. End state: <Subject 1> at a three-quarter angle facing the camera, the hair-pressing hand just lowering, smiling, feet planted on the pavement.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a handheld follow shot: the camera backs up as <Subject 1> walks toward it along the storefront. Passing the tall rubber plant in the terracotta pot, she lightly brushes one leaf with her fingertips and the leaf wobbles gently. She looks down and playfully kicks a dry fallen leaf along the pavement with her toe, then looks up with eyes crinkling into happy crescents. The breeze sweeps hair across her face; she closes her eyes, brushes the strand off her cheek and tucks it behind her ear, then opens her eyes into a clean toothy smile. On the white wall behind her, the black "AFOUR" letters and the small "Open" sign stay legible and unchanged. End state: <Subject 1> standing beside the small spindle-back chair, hands back at her sides, smiling at the lens.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot in front of the white wall. <Subject 1> turns and perches onto the seat of the small spindle-back chair, which stays firmly in place under her. She clasps her hands behind her back, leans her upper body slightly forward, and gives a small playful shrug with a pouty grin that breaks into a mischievous smile, head tilted. Warm rim light outlines her bun against the white wall; the "AFOUR" letters remain visible at the edge of the frame. End state: <Subject 1> seated on the small chair, hands clasped behind her back, leaning slightly forward, head tilted, smiling at the camera.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to a quiet close-up with <Subject 1> still seated; the sheer white curtains of the window glow softly behind her in shallow focus. She lifts one hand and lets a streak of warm sunlight fall across her palm, her eyes drifting toward the light with lips slightly parted in a dreamy, absent look. Her gaze then returns to the lens; she gives one soft blink and a faint closed-lip smile blooms with a small head tilt to the other side, a loose strand drifting across her cheek in the breeze, holding this gentle expression steady until the final frame. End state: seated close-up, hand lowered out of frame, faint smile, eyes resting on the lens.

overall_soundscape:

Quiet afternoon side-street ambience throughout: a soft breeze through leaves, distant muffled traffic, faint café interior murmur with an occasional gentle cup clink behind the window, quiet footsteps on terrazzo pavement, one soft leaf rustle when the rubber-plant leaf is touched in [Shot 2], a tiny dry-leaf skitter under her toe in [Shot 2], and a small wooden chair creak when she sits in [Shot 3].

non_diegetic_music:

A warm, nostalgic indie-folk cue: fingerpicked acoustic guitar with light glockenspiel sparkle and a soft wordless vocal hum; it swells gently through the shrug moment in [Shot 3] and thins out to a single sparse guitar line under the final close-up, keeping a dreamy, tender mood.
